scope: Source audit of rendered Data side-panel controls against EXT-F-2005 and docs/feature-tests.md. No runtime behavior is claimed.

source_census.result: The rendered DataView actions found in these sources correspond to existing inventory controls C01-C32. No additional direct DataView button was confidently identified. One proposed inventory delta, C33, is the visible automatic no_match state; remaining findings concern procedures or the pre-existing T05 fixture prerequisite.

gaps.why_missing: No targeted procedure checks picker hover highlight, Clear, or Cancel after at least one field has been selected. The reviewed guest run 38050967096 covers only Cancel with an empty picker; it does not cover the selected-then-Cancel path. The existing two-field guest path exercises picking and Done, but not these interactions.
procedure: In a controlled ordinary page, start Data field picking and move the pointer over a page element; observe the highlight, then click the element and observe its picker-list entry.
Click Clear and verify the picked entry disappears and the picker list is empty.

Start a fresh pick, select one page element, and click the picker overlay Cancel. Verify the overlay closes without returning that selected field; Data shows no selected fields. Do not save a pattern.
Repeat hover, Clear and selected-then-Cancel as guest, member and admin. Keep the earlier guest empty-picker Cancel result scoped to run 38050967096.
expected: Hover visibly tracks the page element and clicking adds a field entry.
Clear removes every currently picked entry.
Cancel after a selection exits without returning the picked field. Data remains without selected fields; no pattern write occurs.
Record each role separately; existing guest empty-picker Cancel evidence does not establish these remaining interactions.

gaps.why_missing: No existing case maps the auto-extraction running, success, no_match, or error states. T02 exercises a user-triggered matching-pattern run and does not establish the automatic state badges or rows. The auto-extract hook returns early when signed out, so guest is not applicable to this automatic path.
procedure: As a member with a disposable saved pattern matching a controlled page, open that page with Data available and observe the automatic extraction running state.
Use a controlled successful extraction fixture; inspect the automatic success state and rows.
Use a controlled matching-pattern fixture that produces no matching data; inspect the visible auto · no match state and its explanatory text.

Use a separate controlled failure fixture; inspect the auto failed state and visible error, then verify the manual Extract/Re-run action remains available when page identity is ready. Repeat these applicable states as admin.
expected: The running, success-with-rows, no_match, and failure states each correspond to their controlled fixture outcome.
For failure, the error is visible and manual Extract/Re-run remains available when page identity is ready.
Auto-extracted rows render as JSON text in the Data view; this procedure does not claim or test a CopyMenu for those rows.
Member and admin results are recorded separately. Guest is not applicable to the automatic path because the source guard requires signed-in state.

Expected result is that Retry resolves only the current tab/document and no stale identity enables picker or extraction work.
